title: Sevoflurane-Remifentanil Anaesthesia. The Risk of Post Operative Nausea
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether sevoflurane-remifentanil anaesthesia is similar to propofol-remifentanil anaesthesia concerning post- operative nausea and vomiting.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Females younger than 50 years
* ASA I-II
* Scheduled to gynaecological laparotomies or laparoscopies

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medication known to act anti-emetic
* ASA status greater than II
* Malignant hyperthermia
* Allergy to the drugs used.
